description: Draws one standalone figure in the user's Wren notebook, large on its own page: a graph, labelled diagram, chart, table, timeline, flowchart, mind map, concept map, number line or shapes. Figure only, no text blocks (write_notebook_page pages can hold figure blocks next to text). No target: a new note. target.noteId: a new page at the end of that note; with target.pageNumber: drawn onto that page if Wren wrote it (mode append keeps its ink, replace redraws it). The result includes noteUrl, a private link that opens in the user's Wren account after sign-in. Wren emails the user a link to their first note saved here.

course.description: Course name, printed on the notebook cover.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag of the page text; sets the writing direction (right-to-left or left-to-right).

subject.description: Subject, printed on the notebook cover and used to file the note.

content.description: graph_2d {prompt:"y = x^2 - 4"} (one equation) or {xRange,yRange,curves:[{equation}]}; formula {latex}; table {headers,rows}; bar_chart {bars:[{label,value}],title?}; timeline {events:[{id,at,label}]}; flowchart {nodes:[{id,label}],edges:[{from,to}]}; mindmap {root:{id,label},branches:[{id,label,children?}]}; concept_map {nodes,edges:[{from,to,label}]}; labelled_diagram {center,outline?,labels:[{text,shape?}]}; number_line {min,max,step?,marks?:[{value,label?}]}; shapes {shapes:[{shape,x,y,w,h,label?}]} (x,y,w,h 0..1).

subject.description: Subject a new note is filed under.

name: draw_figure

noteUrl.description: Private link to the note in the user's Wren account (opens after sign-in).

title: Draw one figure in Wren
